cards.text: Elijah just had the biggest day of his life on Mount Carmel. Now Ahab, king of Israel, goes and tells his wife Jezebel (1 Kings 16:31) everything Elijah did, including how he killed all the prophets with the sword. Friend, you can feel this one coming.

cards.question: Jezebel hears it all. What does she do about Elijah?

answers.text: Sends him a messenger with a threat
Sends him a gift to make peace

cards.text: Her message: by this time tomorrow, she'll make his life like the lives of those he killed. Friend, that's not a threat. That's a CALENDAR INVITE.

cards.question: After everything on Mount Carmel, Elijah stands his ground and stays put when Jezebel's message comes. True or false?

cards.text: Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. Big day on the mountain, then one message, and he's GONE. I'm not judging, friend. I spent years in a junk drawer flinching every time it rattled.

cards.question: Elijah runs until he reaches ___ in Judah.

cards.text: He leaves his servant there and goes a day's journey into the wilderness, alone. Then he sits down under a broom tree, and I think he's running on empty.

cards.question: Alone under the broom tree, what does Elijah pray for?

answers.text: That the rain would keep falling

cards.text: Elijah says, "I have had enough, LORD," and then, "Take my life, for I am no better than my fathers." Then he lies down under the broom tree and falls asleep.

cards.question: While Elijah sleeps under the broom tree, who touches him?

cards.text: The angel says, "Get up and eat." Elijah looks around. I bet he's thinking, eat WHAT? This is the wilderness, friend.

cards.question: What does Elijah find right there by his head in the wilderness?

answers.text: A cake of bread and a jar of water
A basket of figs and a jug of milk
A bowl of stew and a cup of wine

cards.text: Bread baked over hot coals, right by his head. Room service in the WILDERNESS! Elijah eats, drinks and lies right back down.

cards.question: After Elijah lies back down, the angel lets him sleep and never comes back. True or false?
The angel of the LORD touches Elijah a second time and tells him to get up and eat again. Why?

answers.text: The journey will be too much for him
Jezebel's messenger is about to find him
His servant is coming to take him home

cards.text: So Elijah gets up, eats and drinks. Two meals from an angel, friend. I sat on the Millers' counter for YEARS and never once got served.

cards.question: Strengthened by that food, Elijah walks for ___ days and nights.
Where does Elijah's long walk finally end?

answers.text: Carmel the mountain by the sea

cards.text: On the mountain, Elijah enters a cave and spends the night. After that walk, I bet a cave feels like a five-star hotel. Then the word of the LORD comes to him with a question.

cards.question: In the cave, what does the LORD ask Elijah?

answers.text: What are you doing here Elijah
Why did you leave Judah Elijah
Who told you to come here Elijah

cards.text: Elijah replies, "I have been very zealous for the LORD, the God of Hosts," and then says the Israelites have forsaken His covenant, torn down His altars and killed His prophets with the sword.

cards.question: In the cave, Elijah tells the LORD he is the only one left. True or false?

cards.text: "I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well." Then the LORD tells him to go out and stand on the mountain, because the LORD is about to pass by.

cards.question: Before the LORD on the mountain, what comes first, tearing into the mountains and shattering the rocks?

cards.text: But the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind comes an earthquake, and the LORD was not in the earthquake either. Rocks SHATTERING, ground shaking. Friend, I'd have been back in that cave hugging my gold base.

cards.question: After the earthquake on the mountain, a third thing comes. What is it?
The LORD was in the fire on the mountain. True or false?

cards.text: Wind. Earthquake. FIRE. All the big stuff, and the LORD wasn't in any of it. Then, after the fire, comes a still, small voice.

cards.question: When Elijah hears the still small voice, what does he do?

answers.text: Wraps his face in his cloak and steps out
Runs deeper into the back of the cave
Falls facedown and stays inside the cave

cards.text: He stands at the mouth of the cave. Then a voice asks him the same question as before: "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

cards.question: This time, Elijah gives the LORD a completely different answer than he gave the first time. True or false?

cards.text: Elijah's still on the mountain of God. Now the LORD gives him a job: go back the way he came, to the Desert of Damascus. Kind of like me, friend. I told the angel my edges were gone, and I walked out with a whole BAKERY.

cards.question: In the Desert of Damascus, who is Elijah told to anoint as king over Aram?
The LORD also tells Elijah to anoint ___ as king over Israel and ___ to succeed him as prophet.

cards.text: Jehu will put to death whoever escapes Hazael's sword, and Elisha will put to death whoever escapes Jehu's. Then the LORD adds one more thing.

cards.question: How many in Israel has the LORD reserved whose knees have not bowed to Baal?

cards.text: SEVEN THOUSAND. Elijah said he was the only one left, and there are seven thousand more! Then Elijah leaves and finds Elisha son of Shaphat, plowing with twelve teams of oxen. He's with the twelfth.

cards.question: Elijah passes by Elisha in the field. What does he throw around him?

cards.text: Elisha leaves the oxen and RUNS after Elijah. Plow in the dirt, twelve teams standing there. He's OUT.

cards.question: Elisha asks Elijah for one thing before he follows him. What is it?

answers.text: To kiss his father and mother goodbye
To finish plowing the whole field first
To bring his brothers along with him

cards.text: Elijah replies, "Go on back, for what have I done to you?" So Elisha turns back.

cards.question: Elisha takes his pair of oxen back to the farm and keeps working them. True or false?
What does Elisha do with his pair of oxen?

answers.text: Slaughters them and feeds the people
Gives them to his father to keep
Sells them to pay for the trip

cards.text: He uses the oxen's equipment for fuel, cooks the meat and gives it to the people, and they eat. Friend, that's not a goodbye party. He burned the PLOW.

cards.question: After the people eat, what does Elisha do?

answers.text: Sets out to follow and serve Elijah
Goes home to live with his parents
Returns to plowing the next morning
